Preferences and persistence ​

Persist language and theme choices per application owner. Keep business caches isolated by scope and bind component messages to the same locale as the host dictionary.

Use and API ​

Import createPreferences, memoryStorage, and createBusinessCache from @asam-ui/pro/application/preferences. Choose a storage adapter and supply explicit owner and scope keys. See the preferences and cache API and integration guidance.

Examples ​

Try the example ​

Open the example to switch locale or theme, try storage failures, and check how scoped values expire or return after switching scopes.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	chooseTheme(event.detail);
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, provide, ref } from 'vue';
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import {
	AsamApplicationProvider,
	AsamAdminLayout,
	AsamPageContainer
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamMenu, AsamMenuItem, AsamOption, AsamSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamLayoutSettingsValue } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createNavigation, NavigationView } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import {
	createPreferences,
	bindPreferencesI18n,
	createBusinessCache,
	browserStorage,
	memoryStorage
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import type { StorageAdapter, ThemeChoice } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { dictionaries } from './dictionaries.js';
import BusinessPage from './BusinessPage.vue';
import { preferenceKey } from './context.js';
const normal = browserStorage();
const memory = memoryStorage();
const storageMode = ref('normal');
const storage: StorageAdapter = {
	getItem(key) {
		if (storageMode.value === 'throwing') throw new Error('demo failure');
		return (storageMode.value === 'memory' ? memory : normal)?.getItem(key) ?? null;
	},
	setItem(key, value) {
		if (storageMode.value === 'throwing' || (!normal && storageMode.value === 'normal'))
			throw new Error('demo unavailable');
		(storageMode.value === 'memory' ? memory : normal)!.setItem(key, value);
	},
	removeItem(key) {
		if (storageMode.value === 'throwing' || (!normal && storageMode.value === 'normal'))
			throw new Error('demo unavailable');
		(storageMode.value === 'memory' ? memory : normal)!.removeItem(key);
	}
};
const preferences = createPreferences({
	app: 'preferences-example',
	owner: ['demo-user'],
	storage,
	dictionaries,
	fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN',
	initial: { locale: 'zh-CN', theme: 'system' },
	system:
		typeof window === 'undefined'
			? undefined
			: window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
});
const i18nScope = bindPreferencesI18n(preferences, { fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN' });
provide(preferenceKey, preferences);
const themes: ThemeChoice[] = ['light', 'dark', 'system'];
const sizes: AsamControlSize[] = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const layoutSettings = ref<Partial<AsamLayoutSettingsValue>>({});
const scope = ref('A');
const cacheTtl = 1500;
const cache = createBusinessCache({
	app: 'preferences-example',
	owner: ['demo-user'],
	scope: [scope.value],
	storage,
	version: 1,
	ttl: cacheTtl,
	validate: (value): value is string => typeof value === 'string'
});
const cacheDraft = ref('');
const showPreview = ref(true);
const router = useRouter();
const controller = createNavigation({
	i18n: i18nScope,
	router,
	components: { business: BusinessPage },
	fallback: '/safe',
	load: async () => [
		{ id: 'home', path: '/home', title: 'home', resource: 'business', pinned: true },
		{ id: 'notes', path: '/notes', title: 'notes', resource: 'business' }
	]
});
const activeRoute = computed(
	() => controller.tabs.value.find((tab) => tab.id === controller.active.value)?.routeId ?? ''
);
async function tabKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
	if (!['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
	event.preventDefault();
	const buttons = [
		...((event.currentTarget as HTMLElement)
			.closest('[role="tablist"]')
			?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="tab"]') ?? [])
	];
	const current = buttons.indexOf(event.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement);
	const index =
		event.key === 'Home'
			? 0
			: event.key === 'End'
				? buttons.length - 1
				: (current + (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 1) + buttons.length) %
					buttons.length;
	const tab = controller.tabs.value[index];
	if (tab && (await controller.navigate(tab.fullPath))) {
		await nextTick();
		buttons[index]?.focus();
	}
}
function selectMenu(id: string) {
	const item = controller.visibleMenu.value.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
	if (item) void controller.navigate(item.path);
}
function chooseLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'string') preferences.choose({ locale: value });
}
function chooseTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark' || value === 'system')
		preferences.choose({ theme: value });
}
function switchScope(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value !== 'string') return;
	scope.value = value;
	cache.switchScope([scope.value]);
}
onMounted(async () => {
	await controller.reload();
	if (router.currentRoute.value.path === '/') await controller.navigate('/home', true);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	i18nScope.dispose();
	preferences.dispose();
	cache.dispose();
	controller.dispose();
});
defineExpose({ preferences, cache, controller, i18nScope });
</script>

import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import App from './App.vue';
import BusinessPage from './BusinessPage.vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
const router = createRouter({
	history: createWebHistory(),
	routes: [
		{ path: '/', component: BusinessPage },
		{ path: '/safe', component: BusinessPage },
		{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: BusinessPage }
	]
});
export const app = createApp(App).use(router);
export const view = app.mount('#app');
ts
import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import App from './App.vue';
import BusinessPage from './BusinessPage.vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', component: BusinessPage },
			{ path: '/safe', component: BusinessPage },
			{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: BusinessPage }
		]
	});
	const app = createApp(App).use(router);
	const view = app.mount(element);

	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

	<p role="status">{{ preferences.locale.value }}：{{ preferences.t('hello') }}</p>
	<AsamButton @click="preferences.choose({ locale: 'zh-CN' })" type="primary">中文</AsamButton
	><AsamButton @click="preferences.choose({ locale: 'en' })" type="primary">English</AsamButton
	><AsamButton @click="preferences.reset()" type="primary">恢复默认偏好</AsamButton>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createPreferences, memoryStorage } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
const preferences = createPreferences({
	app: 'preferences-minimal',
	owner: ['local-demo'],
	storage: memoryStorage(),
	dictionaries: { 'zh-CN': { hello: '你好' }, en: { hello: 'Hello' } },
	fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN'
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => preferences.dispose());
</script>

ts
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import type { App, Component } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import * as entry from './src/inline-entry';
const demo: {
	default: Component;
	scoped?: boolean;
	configure?: (app: App) => void | (() => void) | Promise<void | (() => void)>;
} = entry;
const app = createApp(
	demo.default,
	demo.scoped ? { scopeId: 'application/preferences:demo-application-preferences' } : undefined
);
const cleanup = await demo.configure?.(app);
if (typeof cleanup === 'function') app.onUnmount(cleanup);
app.mount('#app');
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => app.unmount(), { once: true });

md
# preferences完整示例

使用Node22.19+的22.x及pnpm11.9.0。在解压目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor内正常UI/Pro包与锁文件配套；无源码alias或借入node_modules。

src/MinimalExample.vue展示本能力最小用法；完整场景保留原路由、provider及本地fixture。src/mount.ts与根main.ts已经接好启动和释放，不需要手写网站宿主。预览设置检测不到网站侧栏时在原位置显示。会话、请求均为本地合成，不连接真实业务后端。跨能力通过公开Pro叶子入口引用，导航的Vue Router是必要依赖，其他样式/按钮与fixture属于演示宿主。

Tiptap既有传递依赖可能出现peer告警，未通过修改依赖版本掩盖。

本工程默认运行与文档页内相同的最小示例，入口见src/inline-entry.ts。完整App及作者宿主仍保留在src目录中，可按其依赖单独接入。场景源码ZIP保留同名相对路径，正常包仅位于完整工程vendor目录。
md
# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

ts
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	browserStorage,
	createPreferences,
	memoryStorage
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import type { Preferences, StorageAdapter } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';

type Mode = 'browser' | 'memory' | 'unavailable';

/** 每个演示拥有稳定 owner；内存适配器在重建 controller 时保留，刷新后自然丢失。 */
export function usePreferenceSession(scopeId: string) {
	const mode = shallowRef<Mode>('browser');
	const feedback = shallowRef('尚未修改偏好。');
	const memory = memoryStorage();
	const unavailable: StorageAdapter = {
		getItem() {
			throw Error('演示适配器拒绝读取');
		},
		setItem() {
			throw Error('演示适配器拒绝写入');
		},
		removeItem() {
			throw Error('演示适配器拒绝删除');
		}
	};
	const create = () =>
		createPreferences({
			app: 'asam-website-inline-preferences-v1',
			owner: [scopeId, mode.value],
			storage:
				mode.value === 'memory'
					? memory
					: mode.value === 'unavailable'
						? unavailable
						: browserStorage(),
			dictionaries: {
				'zh-CN': { hello: '你好，偏好由本示例独立管理。' },
				en: { hello: 'Hello, this example owns its preferences.' }
			},
			fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN',
			initial: { locale: 'zh-CN', theme: 'light' }
		});
	const current = shallowRef(create());
	const recreate = () => {
		current.value.dispose();
		current.value = create();
		feedback.value = `已释放并重建，读取结果：${current.value.status.value}。`;
	};
	onScopeDispose(() => current.value.dispose());
	return {
		mode,
		feedback,
		locale: computed(() => current.value.locale.value),
		theme: computed(() => current.value.theme.value),
		colorMode: computed(() => current.value.colorMode.value),
		status: computed(() => current.value.status.value),
		message: computed(() => current.value.t('hello')),
		choose(value: Partial<Preferences>) {
			const accepted = current.value.choose(value);
			feedback.value = !accepted
				? '偏好未被接受。'
				: current.value.status.value === 'ok'
					? '偏好已接受并保存到当前存储。'
					: `偏好已在本地接受，未保存：${current.value.status.value}。`;
		},
		setMode(value: Mode) {
			mode.value = value;
			recreate();
		},
		recreate,
		reset() {
			current.value.reset();
			feedback.value = `仅清除当前示例的存储键，结果：${current.value.status.value}。`;
		}
	};
}

	<AsamApplicationProvider
		:config="{
			size,
			colorMode: preferences.colorMode.value,

		}"
		class="preferences-app"
		:data-mode="preferences.colorMode.value"
		><Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"
			><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"
				><section class="preview-control-group">
					<header>

							{{ preferences.t('language') }}
							<AsamSelect
								data-language
								:aria-label="preferences.t('language')"
								:model-value="preferences.locale.value"
								@change="chooseLocale"
								><AsamOption
									v-for="language in Object.keys(dictionaries)"
									:key="language"
									:value="language"
									:label="language"
							/></AsamSelect>
						</div>
						<div data-asam-field-caption>
							{{ preferences.t('theme') }}
							<span
								v-show="!websitePreviewControls"
								data-preview-theme-control
								:data-preview-value="preferences.theme.value"
								v-on="{ 'asam-preview-theme': websitePreviewTheme0 }"
								><AsamSelect
									data-theme
									:aria-label="preferences.t('theme')"
									:model-value="preferences.theme.value"
									@change="chooseTheme"
									><AsamOption
										v-for="mode in themes"
										:key="mode"
										:value="mode"
										:label="preferences.t(mode)" /></AsamSelect
							></span>
						</div>
						<span
							>{{ preferences.t('effective') }}:
							{{ preferences.colorMode.value }}</span
						>
						<div data-asam-field-caption>
							{{ preferences.t('size') }}
							<AsamSelect v-model="size" data-size :aria-label="preferences.t('size')"
								><AsamOption
									v-for="item in sizes"
									:key="item"
									:value="item"
									:label="item"
							/></AsamSelect>
						</div>
						<AsamButton @click="preferences.reset()" type="primary">{{
							preferences.t('reset')
						}}</AsamButton>
						<div data-asam-field-caption>
							{{ preferences.t('storage') }}
							<AsamSelect
								v-model="storageMode"
								data-storage
								:aria-label="preferences.t('storage')"
								><AsamOption
									value="normal"
									:label="preferences.t('normal')" /><AsamOption
									value="memory"
									:label="preferences.t('memory')" /><AsamOption
									value="throwing"
									:label="preferences.t('throwing')"
							/></AsamSelect>
						</div>
					</header></section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider></Teleport
		><AsamAdminLayout
			v-model:settings="layoutSettings"
			:size="size"
			:menu-label="preferences.t('menu')"
			:sidebar-label="preferences.t('menu')"
			><template #header>{{ preferences.t('app') }}</template
			><template #sidebar
				><AsamMenu
					:default-active="activeRoute"
					background-color="var(--asam-color-surface)"
					text-color="var(--asam-color-text-primary)"
					active-text-color="var(--asam-color-primary)"
					@select="selectMenu"
					><AsamMenuItem
						v-for="item in controller.visibleMenu.value"
						:key="item.id"
						:index="item.id"
						>{{ preferences.t(item.title) }}</AsamMenuItem
					></AsamMenu
				></template
			>
			<div role="tablist" :aria-label="preferences.t('app')" class="tabs">
				<div v-for="tab in controller.tabs.value" :key="tab.id">
					<AsamButton
						role="tab"
						type="primary"
						:text="tab.id !== controller.active.value"
						:tabindex="tab.id === controller.active.value ? 0 : -1"
						:aria-selected="tab.id === controller.active.value"
						@keydown="tabKey($event)"
						@click="controller.navigate(tab.fullPath)"
						>{{ preferences.t(tab.title) }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-if="!tab.pinned"
						:aria-label="preferences.t('close') + ' ' + preferences.t(tab.title)"
						@click="controller.close([tab.id])"
						type="primary"
					>
						×
					</AsamButton>
				</div>
			</div>
			<AsamButton @click="controller.refresh()" type="primary">{{
				preferences.t('refresh')
			}}</AsamButton
			><AsamPageContainer :title="preferences.t(activeRoute || 'home')"
				><NavigationView :controller="controller" /></AsamPageContainer
			><Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"
				><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"
					><section class="preview-control-group">
						<section class="cache-panel">
							<div data-asam-field-caption>
								{{ preferences.t('scope') }}
								<AsamSelect
									data-scope
									:aria-label="preferences.t('scope')"
									:model-value="scope"
									@change="switchScope"
									><AsamOption value="A" label="A" /><AsamOption
										value="B"
										label="B"
								/></AsamSelect>
							</div>
							<AsamInput
								v-model="cacheDraft"
								data-cache-draft
								:aria-label="preferences.t('notes')"
							/><AsamButton
								data-save
								@click="cache.write('notes', cacheDraft)"
								type="primary"
								>{{ preferences.t('save') }}</AsamButton
							><AsamButton data-read @click="cache.read('notes')" type="primary">{{
								preferences.t('read')
							}}</AsamButton
							><AsamButton data-clear @click="cache.clear()" type="primary">{{
								preferences.t('clear')
							}}</AsamButton>
							<p data-cache>{{ cache.value.value ?? preferences.t('empty') }}</p>
							<p>{{ preferences.t('expire') }}: {{ cacheTtl }}ms</p>
						</section>
					</section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
				></Teleport
			>
			<p role="status" data-status>
				{{ preferences.t('storage') }}: {{ preferences.status.value }} /
				{{ cache.status.value }} — <br /><span data-preference-feedback>{{
					preferences.t('preferences.' + preferences.status.value)
				}}</span
				><br /><span data-cache-feedback>{{
					preferences.t('cache.' + cache.status.value)
				}}</span>
			</p></AsamAdminLayout
		>
		<aside v-if="showPreview">
			<AsamApplicationProvider :config="{ colorMode: 'light' }"
				><p data-preview>{{ preferences.t('preview') }}</p></AsamApplicationProvider
			>
		</aside>
		<AsamButton data-preview-toggle @click="showPreview = !showPreview" type="primary">{{
			preferences.t(showPreview ? 'destroy' : 'restore')
		}}</AsamButton></AsamApplicationProvider
	>
</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event) {
	chooseTheme(event.detail);
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value, type) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, provide, ref } from 'vue';
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import {
	AsamApplicationProvider,
	AsamAdminLayout,
	AsamPageContainer
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamMenu, AsamMenuItem, AsamOption, AsamSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createNavigation, NavigationView } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import {
	createPreferences,
	bindPreferencesI18n,
	createBusinessCache,
	browserStorage,
	memoryStorage
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { dictionaries } from './dictionaries.js';
import BusinessPage from './BusinessPage.vue';
import { preferenceKey } from './context.js';
const normal = browserStorage();
const memory = memoryStorage();
const storageMode = ref('normal');
const storage = {
	getItem(key) {
		if (storageMode.value === 'throwing') throw new Error('demo failure');
		return (storageMode.value === 'memory' ? memory : normal)?.getItem(key) ?? null;
	},
	setItem(key, value) {
		if (storageMode.value === 'throwing' || (!normal && storageMode.value === 'normal'))
			throw new Error('demo unavailable');
		(storageMode.value === 'memory' ? memory : normal).setItem(key, value);
	},
	removeItem(key) {
		if (storageMode.value === 'throwing' || (!normal && storageMode.value === 'normal'))
			throw new Error('demo unavailable');
		(storageMode.value === 'memory' ? memory : normal).removeItem(key);
	}
};
const preferences = createPreferences({
	app: 'preferences-example',
	owner: ['demo-user'],
	storage,
	dictionaries,
	fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN',
	initial: { locale: 'zh-CN', theme: 'system' },
	system:
		typeof window === 'undefined'
			? undefined
			: window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
});
const i18nScope = bindPreferencesI18n(preferences, { fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN' });
provide(preferenceKey, preferences);
const themes = ['light', 'dark', 'system'];
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const size = ref('default');
const layoutSettings = ref({});
const scope = ref('A');
const cacheTtl = 1500;
const cache = createBusinessCache({
	app: 'preferences-example',
	owner: ['demo-user'],
	scope: [scope.value],
	storage,
	version: 1,
	ttl: cacheTtl,
	validate: (value) => typeof value === 'string'
});
const cacheDraft = ref('');
const showPreview = ref(true);
const router = useRouter();
const controller = createNavigation({
	i18n: i18nScope,
	router,
	components: { business: BusinessPage },
	fallback: '/safe',
	load: async () => [
		{ id: 'home', path: '/home', title: 'home', resource: 'business', pinned: true },
		{ id: 'notes', path: '/notes', title: 'notes', resource: 'business' }
	]
});
const activeRoute = computed(
	() => controller.tabs.value.find((tab) => tab.id === controller.active.value)?.routeId ?? ''
);
async function tabKey(event) {
	if (!['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
	event.preventDefault();
	const buttons = [
		...(event.currentTarget.closest('[role="tablist"]')?.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]') ?? [])
	];
	const current = buttons.indexOf(event.currentTarget);
	const index =
		event.key === 'Home'
			? 0
			: event.key === 'End'
				? buttons.length - 1
				: (current + (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 1) + buttons.length) %
					buttons.length;
	const tab = controller.tabs.value[index];
	if (tab && (await controller.navigate(tab.fullPath))) {
		await nextTick();
		buttons[index]?.focus();
	}
}
function selectMenu(id) {
	const item = controller.visibleMenu.value.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
	if (item) void controller.navigate(item.path);
}
function chooseLocale(value) {
	if (typeof value === 'string') preferences.choose({ locale: value });
}
function chooseTheme(value) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark' || value === 'system')
		preferences.choose({ theme: value });
}
function switchScope(value) {
	if (typeof value !== 'string') return;
	scope.value = value;
	cache.switchScope([scope.value]);
}
onMounted(async () => {
	await controller.reload();
	if (router.currentRoute.value.path === '/') await controller.navigate('/home', true);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	i18nScope.dispose();
	preferences.dispose();
	cache.dispose();
	controller.dispose();
});
defineExpose({ preferences, cache, controller, i18nScope });
</script>

<template>

import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import App from './App.vue';
import BusinessPage from './BusinessPage.vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
const router = createRouter({
	history: createWebHistory(),
	routes: [
		{ path: '/', component: BusinessPage },
		{ path: '/safe', component: BusinessPage },
		{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: BusinessPage }
	]
});
export const app = createApp(App).use(router);
export const view = app.mount('#app');
js
import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import App from './App.vue';
import BusinessPage from './BusinessPage.vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', component: BusinessPage },
			{ path: '/safe', component: BusinessPage },
			{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: BusinessPage }
		]
	});
	const app = createApp(App).use(router);
	const view = app.mount(element);
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

<template>
	<p role="status">{{ preferences.locale.value }}：{{ preferences.t('hello') }}</p>
	<AsamButton @click="preferences.choose({ locale: 'zh-CN' })" type="primary">中文</AsamButton
	><AsamButton @click="preferences.choose({ locale: 'en' })" type="primary">English</AsamButton
	><AsamButton @click="preferences.reset()" type="primary">恢复默认偏好</AsamButton>
</template>
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createPreferences, memoryStorage } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
const preferences = createPreferences({
	app: 'preferences-minimal',
	owner: ['local-demo'],
	storage: memoryStorage(),
	dictionaries: { 'zh-CN': { hello: '你好' }, en: { hello: 'Hello' } },
	fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN'
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => preferences.dispose());
</script>

# preferences完整示例

使用Node22.19+的22.x及pnpm11.9.0。在解压目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor内正常UI/Pro包与锁文件配套；无源码alias或借入node_modules。

src/MinimalExample.vue展示本能力最小用法；完整场景保留原路由、provider及本地fixture。src/mount.ts与根main.ts已经接好启动和释放，不需要手写网站宿主。预览设置检测不到网站侧栏时在原位置显示。会话、请求均为本地合成，不连接真实业务后端。跨能力通过公开Pro叶子入口引用，导航的Vue Router是必要依赖，其他样式/按钮与fixture属于演示宿主。

Tiptap既有传递依赖可能出现peer告警，未通过修改依赖版本掩盖。

本工程默认运行与文档页内相同的最小示例，入口见src/inline-entry.js。完整App及作者宿主仍保留在src目录中，可按其依赖单独接入。场景源码ZIP保留同名相对路径，正常包仅位于完整工程vendor目录。

# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	browserStorage,
	createPreferences,
	memoryStorage
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
/** 每个演示拥有稳定 owner；内存适配器在重建 controller 时保留，刷新后自然丢失。 */
export function usePreferenceSession(scopeId) {
	const mode = shallowRef('browser');
	const feedback = shallowRef('尚未修改偏好。');
	const memory = memoryStorage();
	const unavailable = {
		getItem() {
			throw Error('演示适配器拒绝读取');
		},
		setItem() {
			throw Error('演示适配器拒绝写入');
		},
		removeItem() {
			throw Error('演示适配器拒绝删除');
		}
	};
	const create = () =>
		createPreferences({
			app: 'asam-website-inline-preferences-v1',
			owner: [scopeId, mode.value],
			storage:
				mode.value === 'memory'
					? memory
					: mode.value === 'unavailable'
						? unavailable
						: browserStorage(),
			dictionaries: {
				'zh-CN': { hello: '你好，偏好由本示例独立管理。' },
				en: { hello: 'Hello, this example owns its preferences.' }
			},
			fallbackLocale: 'zh-CN',
			initial: { locale: 'zh-CN', theme: 'light' }
		});
	const current = shallowRef(create());
	const recreate = () => {
		current.value.dispose();
		current.value = create();
		feedback.value = `已释放并重建，读取结果：${current.value.status.value}。`;
	};
	onScopeDispose(() => current.value.dispose());
	return {
		mode,
		feedback,
		locale: computed(() => current.value.locale.value),
		theme: computed(() => current.value.theme.value),
		colorMode: computed(() => current.value.colorMode.value),
		status: computed(() => current.value.status.value),
		message: computed(() => current.value.t('hello')),
		choose(value) {
			const accepted = current.value.choose(value);
			feedback.value = !accepted
				? '偏好未被接受。'
				: current.value.status.value === 'ok'
					? '偏好已接受并保存到当前存储。'
					: `偏好已在本地接受，未保存：${current.value.status.value}。`;
		},
		setMode(value) {
			mode.value = value;
			recreate();
		},
		recreate,
		reset() {
			current.value.reset();
			feedback.value = `仅清除当前示例的存储键，结果：${current.value.status.value}。`;
		}
	};
}

Complete runnable project ​

Download capability source · Download complete project

The complete project includes the example, matching package artifacts, the lockfile, and required patches. After extracting it, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm run typecheck, and pnpm run dev.

Continue integration

Pro quick start · Application capabilities · Versions and migration · AI development recipe

Reference ​

API and behavior

API Input and output Behavior
createPreferences PreferenceOptions → PreferenceController The owner is fixed for an instance. After disposal, choose returns false.
locale, theme, colorMode Readonly computed values Application language, selected theme, and effective color mode.
choose Partial<Preferences> → boolean Rejects invalid values. A failed write still preserves the session choice.
t Key and string or number interpolation → string Returns plain text. Fallback and issues are observable.
number, date Standard Intl options → string Uses the current locale.
status, issues Readonly refs Statuses include missing, ok, migrated, invalid, future, and unavailable.
reset, dispose No arguments Resets the current owner's preferences or idempotently cleans up listeners, respectively.
createBusinessCache CacheOptions<T> → controller Each scope has a snapshot TTL. Provide a payload validator.
read, write Name or name and value Returns Result<T> or StorageStatus, respectively. Validates the stored data.
remember Name and async loader → Promise<Result<T>> Invalidation prevents late results from restoring data.
switchScope Typed Scope Immediately clears the old scope's visible state and invalidates its asynchronous writes.
clear, reset, invalidate No arguments Removes the current scope envelope and invalidates in-flight work.
dispose No arguments Idempotently invalidates the cache controller. Subsequent operations leave storage alone.
storageKey, encodeScope App, kind, owner, or scope Encodes typed tuples and throws on invalid scope.
browserStorage, memoryStorage No arguments Safely discovers browser storage or creates an independent in-memory adapter, respectively.

See the same-release Types.ts, Cache.ts, and Preferences.ts for the complete fields and result types. status reflects the latest operation. An invalidated remember returns stale and preserves the current scope. The API works with explicit owners and scopes and leaves page lifecycle caching to KeepAlive.

The example's data-preference-feedback and data-cache-feedback regions reflect preferences.status and cache.status, respectively. Each includes bilingual messages for its statuses. Recovery appears after the corresponding operation succeeds. Switching the adapter alone preserves failure feedback. The feedback uses the existing types and storage protocol.

Usage

Import createPreferences, memoryStorage, and createBusinessCache from @asam-ui/pro/application/preferences. Application.preferences on the main package exposes the same implementation. Use import type from the same path. Preferences persist language and theme per owner. The business cache is isolated per scope. Bind component messages to the application's language source explicitly. An additional i18n library is optional. The examples provide the inline demo, source files, and a complete project ZIP.

createPreferences accepts explicit app, owner, storage, dictionaries, fallbackLocale, initial, force, and system options. Precedence runs from the session choice to a valid stored value, then initial, then safe defaults from fallbackLocale and system. Without system media information the effective color mode is light. Host policy in force overrides only the configured fields. Remounting reads persisted preferences before applying initial values. The locale must exist in the host dictionary. An unsupported choice returns false and records an issue. For a missing key, translation checks the fallback dictionary and then returns the key, recording an issue. Interpolation returns plain text. Render with Vue text interpolation and avoid v-html. number and date use Intl.

theme can be light, dark, or system. Pass the effective light or dark value from colorMode to the application configuration provider. Inject the browser's matchMedia for system mode. dispose removes its listeners idempotently. Explicit light and dark modes remain fixed when media changes. The host can map its language to the public Element Plus locale via the provider's base.locale. The app dictionary translates host content. The example composes the menu and tabs with the public navigation controller and NavigationPage. It translates title keys while preserving navigation instances, identities, permissions, and drafts.

Storage keys encode typed tuples in JSON and preserve the distinctions between 0, '0', and null as well as field boundaries. Owner identifies the application's user scope, while business scope identifies a tenant or organization. They use separate namespaces. When the owner changes, dispose the controller and create a new one with an explicit identity. Each controller holds a session snapshot. There is no cross-tab synchronization.

The v2 preference schema is {version:2, owner:key, data:{locale,theme}}. The only supported upgrade is from v1 {version:1,owner:key,data:{language,dark}}. Invalid data, a mismatched owner, future versions, and read failures preserve the original entry. A choice can still take effect in the session. An explicit reset deletes only the current owner's preference key. If deletion fails, the current choice is retained. A failed migration write keeps the original and returns unavailable. Fix storage and remount to retry. Writes use the adapter's atomic single-key setItem; host adapters must provide equivalent semantics.

createBusinessCache<T> requires app, owner, scope, storage, version, ttl, validate, and now. Each scope has one envelope mapping names to values, with a snapshot TTL. Writing any name refreshes the whole scope's TTL. Each read checks version, ownership, payload, and expiry and withholds expired data. The UI displays the last result. Read again after the TTL to observe expired. clear, invalidate, and reset delete the entire current scope envelope. Explicitly clear future or corrupt data before writing. switchScope immediately clears the displayed result. Read the new scope explicitly. Switching back allows another read of unexpired data.

remember captures the current invalidation generation at the start. Late results or errors after switchScope, clear, reset, or dispose cannot write to storage. Host network requests continue independently. Concurrent requests in the same generation commit in completion order. Cache business data only and keep credentials, subjects, and permission copies elsewhere. Page-instance caching is separate. Use the navigation controller's refresh or close to release those instances.

The example has bilingual menus, tabs, actions, and empty and error feedback. Try all four sizes, system/light/dark themes, a local light provider, normal/in-memory/failing storage, business scopes, and a 1,500 ms TTL. Change the dictionaries, initial preferences, or cacheTtl to see the effect.

The core can initialize without window or storage and report unavailable. The host supplies system theme information. The full example's main.ts uses web history and browser mounting. Verify full SSR hydration in the host. Storage uses synchronous adapters and provides no encryption, server translation, arbitrary historical migrations, or authentication.

Preference storage and business cache each display their own localized status. Switching back to a working adapter alone preserves failure feedback. A successful operation clears feedback on its own side. Valid session choices and drafts remain available during failures.

Component messages and preference language ​

Keep the existing business dictionary, theme, and storage choices. From the same public entry point, call bindPreferencesI18n(preferences, options?) to read the locale from an existing preferences controller. To create both, use createPreferencesI18n(preferenceOptions, i18nOptions?), which returns { preferences, i18n, dispose }. Pass its i18n to AsamApplicationProvider through config.base.i18n and call binding.dispose() on unmount. A binding created from an existing controller disposes its i18n scope and leaves preferences with the original owner.

Choose browserStorage() or another adapter explicitly and supply app and owner to persist preferences. The binding reads the supplied scope. It creates no global singleton and performs no browser language detection. Translate business titles with the preferences dictionary and component keys with i18n. Existing Intl options control number and date formatting. Changing locale preserves model values.

Existing projects can keep createPreferences and add a one-way binding. Use the scope's built-in mapping or configure nativeLocales explicitly for Element Plus. Explicit configuration such as base.locale follows the documented precedence. See Language and locale for default Chinese and English messages, overrides and extensions, separate 1.0 and 2.0 quick starts, and a runnable persistence example.

export type ScopePart = string | number | null;
export type Scope = readonly ScopePart[];
export type ThemeChoice = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
export interface StorageAdapter {
	getItem(key: string): string | null;
	setItem(key: string, value: string): void;
	removeItem(key: string): void;
}
export type StorageStatus =
	| 'missing'
	| 'ok'
	| 'migrated'
	| 'invalid'
	| 'future'
	| 'expired'
	| 'unavailable'
	| 'disposed'
	| 'stale';
export interface Result<T> {
	status: StorageStatus;
	value?: T;
}
export interface Preferences {
	locale: string;
	theme: ThemeChoice;
}
export interface SystemTheme {
	matches: boolean;
	addEventListener(type: 'change', listener: (event: { matches: boolean }) => void): void;
	removeEventListener(type: 'change', listener: (event: { matches: boolean }) => void): void;
}
export interface PreferenceOptions {
	app: string;
	owner: Scope;
	storage?: StorageAdapter;
	dictionaries: Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, string>>>>;
	fallbackLocale: string;
	initial?: Partial<Preferences>;
	/** Explicit host policy, separate from initial defaults. */
	force?: Partial<Preferences>;
	system?: SystemTheme;
	onIssue?: (issue: string) => void;
}
